feed.title: Daylight: Zoning cases, District 13
feed.subtitle: Each zoning case whose agenda prints District 13, at each meeting it appears at. Cases that print no district are in the Rezoning feed. Daylight is an independent, unofficial site run by gnoshcodes. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the City of Clarksville, Montgomery County, the Clarksville-Montgomery County School System (CMCSS), or the Clarksville-Montgomery County Regional Planning Commission. The official record held by each body controls.
